statement_html:
Compute the volume of the tegrahedron in the cartesian space whose 4 vertices are
\(A\) = (8,3,-9) , \(B\) = (1,-7,-11) , \(C\) = (5,0,-15) , \(D\) = (1,10,-16) .
Enter your reply:
=
hint_html:
A tetrahedron is a polyhedron in the space with 4 vertices.

If one takes 4 adjacent vertices of a parallelepiped, the tetrahedron generated by these 4 vertices has a volume which is 1/6 that of the parallelepiped.

The volume of the parallelepiped can be computed via the cross product of vectors.
